question: Which Indian player won the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Sindhu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• PV Sindhu is the first Indian woman to win two consecutive medals at Olympics-** silver in the 2016 Rio Games and bronze at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.**
 
• Sindhu ended 2021 with a silver at the Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
• She was also the winner of the Syed Modi International Badminton title in January 2022.
 
• She became the** first Indian to win a historic Gold at the Badminton World Championships in 2019.**
 
• She also **won the inaugural BBC Indian Sportswoman of the year award in 2019 following a public vote.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year Award:**

 
 
• It is an initiative by the BBC Hindi in India to celebrate and honour sportswomen from India who have excelled in their respective fields.
 
• The first edition of the award took place in 2020, and P.V. Sindhu was the winner.
 
• The latest edition of the award took place in 2022, and Mirabai Chanu was the winner.
